Title: Public Preview: Graph Query Language (GQL) in KQL graph semantics

Body.Content:
We’re adding Graph Query Language (GQL) support to KQL graph semantics, aligned with the ISO standard. This update allows you to run GQL queries on any Fabric Eventhouse or Azure Data Explorer, making it easier to work with graph data using an industry-standard language.

Learn more:
  • Explore the GQL overview, reference and best practices in our documentation
  • Discover KQL graph semantics samples to use GQL with
